candidates.name: KS Yuzhno-Balykskaya - Nefteyugansk Gas Pipeline (GRS Karkateevy, GRS Pyt-Yakh)
candidates.to: Nefteyugansk (via GRS Karkateevy and GRS Pyt-Yakh), KhMAO

evidence.note: Gazprom commissioned new gas complex in Nefteyugansk district: takeoff pipeline >47 km plus inter-settlement network, total >130 km; GRS Karkateevy 79k m3/h and second GRS 42k m3/h.
Earlier announcement of the takeoff for Nefteyugansk gas supply (length ~47.5 km per search snippet; verify in page).
Commissioning of largest takeoff for Nefteyugansk and Pyt-Yakh, two years late.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for a KS Yuzhno-Balykskaya/Nefteyugansk/Pyt-Yakh branch; nearest are trunk P5414/P2440 (Urengoy-Chelyabinsk) which it taps, not matches. Length ~47.3-47.5 km; diameter unknown. Also an inter-settlement network from GRS Karkateevy to Nefteyugansk exists (separate sub-segments, length unknown).

candidates.name: Eastern Gas Supply System (Yamal stage) - KS-3 Obskaya to KS-4 Yarsaltinskaya incl. Ob Bay underwater crossing

evidence.note: Two lines across Ob Bay, about 39 km each, KS-3 Obskaya to KS-4 Yarsaltinskaya; contract price cut to 1.097 bn rub; surveys underway; public discussion 25 Sep-24 Oct 2026; part of Eastern Gas Supply System (28.5 bcm/y).
Eastern Gas Supply System >5,000 km from Yamal to Khabarovsk Krai, 28.5 bcm/y; Belogorsk-Khabarovsk first stage.
Route via Yamal, KhMAO, Tomsk, Kemerovo, Krasnoyarsk, Irkutsk regions.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster has only the Belogorsk-Khabarovsk piece (P5521) and Power of Siberia rows; no Yamal-to-Siberia Eastern System row. Two parallel ~39 km Ob Bay lines; could be split per line. Not P2358 (Gazprom Neft Gas of Yamal, Novoportovskoye-Yamburg). Whole-system length >5,000 km incl. Yamal, KhMAO sections not further detailed.
